fabrics.name: Aircool
fabrics.description: A breathable performance option suited to active uniforms, polos and sportswear where airflow and comfort matter.

image.alt: Illustrative close-up of a light perforated performance fabric.

fabrics.name: Lacoste
fabrics.description: A structured knit look commonly suited to polos and smart casual uniforms that need a more premium hand feel.

image.alt: Illustrative close-up of a structured grey knit fabric.

fabrics.name: Polydex
fabrics.description: A versatile polyester option for sublimation and customized sports or event garments where print clarity matters.

image.alt: Illustrative close-up of a dense charcoal polyester knit.

fabrics.name: Drifit
fabrics.description: A performance-oriented fabric direction designed for active use, helping garments feel lighter during movement.

image.alt: Illustrative close-up of a dark technical knit fabric.

fabrics.name: Microshine
fabrics.description: A smooth synthetic surface with a subtle sheen, useful where a cleaner technical appearance is preferred.

image.alt: Illustrative close-up of a smooth pink fabric with a subtle sheen.

faqs.question: Can I submit my own design?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the design together with quantity, deadline and garment requirements so the team can review production feasibility.

faqs.question: Do you accept rush orders?
faqs.answer: Rush feasibility depends on the current production load, product type, quantity and required completion date.

faqs.question: What details should I prepare?
faqs.answer: Prepare your product, design, quantity, size breakdown, fabric preference and target deadline.

faqs.question: Can orders use mixed sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A size breakdown can be included in your quotation or order details.

productionPreparation.title: Garment & fabric
productionPreparation.description: Choose your product and share your fabric preference. If you’re still deciding, explore the available materials before preparing your brief.

productionPreparation.title: Design & customization
productionPreparation.description: Bring your design or reference, with the logos, print details or embroidery you have in mind. Include names and numbers for personalized teamwear.

productionPreparation.title: Quantity & sizes
productionPreparation.description: Prepare a quantity for each size. For team orders, collect names, numbers and sizes in one final list, and check that it matches the total quantity.

productionPreparation.title: Your target deadline
productionPreparation.description: Include your required completion date with your garment and quantity details so the team can review production feasibility.

productionQuestions.question: Can I submit my own design?
productionQuestions.answer: Yes. Send the design together with quantity, deadline and garment requirements so the team can review production feasibility.

productionQuestions.question: Do you accept rush orders?
productionQuestions.answer: Rush feasibility depends on the current production load, product type, quantity and required completion date.

productionQuestions.question: When is the final price confirmed?
productionQuestions.answer: Final price is confirmed by Ganesh after design, material and production requirements are checked.
